description: Delivery and return fees for a route with one courier.

credentials.description: The caller's own credentials for that courier, 1-8 string fields. Never stored. Omit entirely for the sandbox courier.

baseUrl.description: Tenant URL, accepted only for the generic "ecotrack" courier and only under *.ecotrack.dz. Every other courier has its own key and takes no URL.
